title: Choose the visual world for the money app
question: The roll assigned the Banknote Series. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Banknote Series
options.lineage: Modern currency design (Swiss 9th series, Dutch guilders)
options.thesis: Every category is a denomination: one calm hue each, set on clean white like a well-designed note series.
options.viewport: Side rail, net worth with 6-month line, this month's budgets as denomination-colored bars, review queue count, next bills.
options.risk: Six category hues can turn into a rainbow if they leak beyond charts and budget bars.

raised.raise: One strict 10-step neutral ramp is the only grey; no ad-hoc greys anywhere.
Every month-to-month comparison is drawn on one fixed scale, so months compare honestly.
One 8px grid; figures align in tabular columns across every screen.
A short type scale; rank comes from weight and figures, not big size jumps.

options.label: Kakeibo Household Ledger
options.thesis: The monthly money ritual: plan, record, reflect, on calm pages that celebrate what was saved.
options.viewport: This month as a spread: income and savings goal at top, budgets as ruled rows, a reflection line at the bottom.
options.risk: Familiar warm-paper look; most calm finance apps land close to this.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Each transaction is a coupon: pending, posted, and removed states stamp on, nothing silently disappears.
options.viewport: Transactions as a coupon column with stamped states; a wallet summary shows what remains of the month.
options.case: Strong on transaction states; household members do not identify with airline paperwork.
options.risk: Navy and red can feel official rather than calm.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: Months as fixed-scale plates of one growing plant.
options.viewport: Five month plates on one baseline.
options.case: Growth reads encouraging, but money is not a plant; clarity suffers.
options.kept: Same exact scale for every month comparison.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.thesis: Data as hatched zones on a tonal ramp.
options.case: Nobody in the household thinks in darkroom zones.
options.kept: A single strict tonal ramp as the only neutrals.

options.label: Crouwel Grid
options.thesis: The construction grid is the design.
options.case: Too poster-like for a daily tool.
options.kept: One strict grid with aligned tabular figures.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean modern finance dashboard in the style of Monarch and Copilot, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, greeting, net worth chart card, budget cards, recent transactions.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every finance app by design.
